purpose: Teach: マルコ/スティーブ/フィリップ/ムーア/ファーム/ヨシ/アール/服部

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、海外留学でマルコと友達になったろ
lines.en: Riku — you made friends with Marco when you went abroad for that exchange year, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing challenge. Leans forward slightly. Soft emphasis on the memory — she's testing to see if he remembers she was paying attention. Not accusatory, just playful.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英会話の先生スティーブだったよな、桜
lines.en: Your English teacher was Steve, remember? That was you, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle deflection with a half-smile underneath. Lets the accusation land soft. Turns it back on her — she knows things about him, he knows things about her. Equal ground.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英王室のフィリップ親王の本読んでたな
lines.en: Riku — you were reading that book about Prince Philip from the UK, weren't you?
lines.style: Specific recall, satisfied. Slight rise at the end like she's enjoying the fact she caught this detail. Quick delivery. Not mocking, just evidence she's been watching.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽でムーアのギター好きだったろ、桜
lines.en: You really liked that guitarist Moore's music, didn't you? Remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Small smile in the voice — he's naming something she loves. Not performing for her, just stating what he knows. Quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、プロ野球のファーム選手追ってたな
lines.en: Riku — you were following those farm team players in the professional leagues.
lines.style: Impressed recall. Slight quickening — this is a specific, slightly obscure interest and she noticed it. Eyebrow-raise in the voice. Genuine, not condescending.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームでヨシ、つまりヨッシー操作上手だったな、桜
lines.en: You used to be really good at Yoshi in games — you know, the character? You'd control him perfectly, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment with a smile underneath. He's praising something small she probably forgot he noticed. Gentle, not trying too hard. The voice of someone who remembers because it mattered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ノートにアール、つまりRの落書きしてたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw all those doodles of the letter R in your notebook.
lines.style: Knowing pause before the reveal. Dry, almost amused. She's caught something and she knows exactly what it means. Light, not accusatory, but definitely aware. Slight smirk underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、忍者漫画で服部半蔵が一番好きだったろ、桜
lines.en: You had Hattori Hanzo as your favorite ninja character in those comics, didn't you? That was you, Sakura.
lines.style: Close and quiet, almost intimate. He's returning the volley — she's remembered his things, now he's showing he remembers hers too. Slight vulnerability in admitting he was paying this close attention. Eye contact level.
